description: This file defines the ReportToDecorator class, which provides methods for managing employee reporting relationships within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for setting supervisor and subordinate employees by their employee number, as well as setting the reporting method by its ID. The class uses traits for ORM helper functions and interacts with the ReportTo, Employee, and ReportingMethod entities.

classes.name: ReportToDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the ReportTo entity, providing methods to assign supervisor, subordinate, and reporting method relationships.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a ReportTo entity instance.

methods.name: setSupervisorEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the supervisor for the report-to relationship using an employee number.

methods.name: setSubordinateEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the subordinate for the report-to relationship using an employee number.

methods.name: setReportingMethodByReportingMethodId
methods.description: Sets the reporting method for the report-to relationship using a reporting method ID.
